نتساكن (form VI)
# نَتَسَاكَنُ (natasākanu) /na.ta.saː.ka.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاكَنَ (tasākana)
# نَتَسَاكَنَ (natasākana) /na.ta.saː.ka.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاكَنَ (tasākana)
# نَتَسَاكَنْ (natasākan) /na.ta.saː.kan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاكَنَ (tasākana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
